title: A great way to see the city
text: Pablo was amazing and so knowledgeable. We had the best time on this Segway tour. Thank you Pablo for making our Barcelona trip so memorable.
author: D6926VFjessd

title: Segway to see Barcelona!
text: I booked this as the first thing I did when I got to Barcelona after checking into the hotel. It was a great way to see the city. I booked a group tour, but I was the only customer, and the guide suggested rather than going up to Segrada Família we explore the whole city. We did and it was really lovely - I actually recommend this as a way to get a lay of the land and see the city.
author: Shilpi_M

title: The Barcelonian Past
text: I arrived early and was disappointed to see the door locked. However, at exactly 10 o’clock the door was opened. A single guide took me to the closest mini park where I could practice riding the Segway. His emphasis on safety was impressive. We did not start the actual riding until nearly twenty minutes past ten however at the end of the trip we went another twenty minutes past twelve o’clock. We never did approach a Sagrada Familia, but that was after a conversation as to the way we should go. I would recommend a different tour for someone who just wanted to go to the cathedral. author: David_W

title: A MUST DO!
text: My wife and I decided to do the Segway tour with Pablo while starting our honeymoon in Barcelona.  Out of everything we did, this was the best. He was very attentive to our needs, customized a tour based on what we wanted to see, and had all the history and back stories to make it a memorable experience to remember. I highly recommend this place.  We even got some advice and options on what to do for the rest of our stay, before departing on our cruise like places to go, things to see, and restaurants to try. You can really tell the difference of someone who truly cares and takes pride in what
author: matthew_s

title: Nice excursion
text: It was a nice break feom our regular ship shore excursions. It was a private tour. We got to see a number of sites and had some beautiful views while we went all around the city on our Segway.
author: Suzi_W

title: So much fun!
text: We had a great time! Neither of us had ever been on a Segway and the guide made sure that we were comfortable before taking off. We enjoyed that the tour was just us and not a big group of people. Our guide was very nice and knowledgeable. Highly recommend giving this a try, I don’t think you’d be disappointed!
author: Amanda_D

title: Barcelona Segway Fun
text: Philip with Eurosegway tours is an awesome tour guide and Segway instructor. Was our first time using segways and after our tutorial we felt comfortable and safe while riding around Barcelona. Highly recommend doing this tour if you come to this wonderful city.
author: Lester_S

title: Very nice and friendly...
text: Very nice and friendly guide. The Segway ride is defiantly something people should try once in Barcelona!
author: Rui_Z

title: Excellent tour!!
text: We had a pretty large group (13) and they divided us into 2 groups. Both our guides were great, and full of lots of interesting information. It was best Segway tour I have been on and will do it again the next time we are in Barcelona. Worth every penny!
author: cwelsh7

title: Very informative tour on Segways
text: I was very happy to see this tours, i have tried Segway couple times before. The tour was great, the guide gave us too much information and history, worth every cent!
author: TomWilliamsTraveler
